## UnexpectedRequirementSignatureError class

Thrown when `buildTx` receives a requirement signature of a kind the operation does not consume. Surfacing it prevents a signed requirement from being silently ignored.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare class UnexpectedRequirementSignatureError extends Error
```
**Extends:** Error

## Example


```ts
import { UnexpectedRequirementSignatureError } from "@morpho-org/morpho-sdk";

if (error instanceof UnexpectedRequirementSignatureError) {
  // Remove the signature this operation does not use from the buildTx array.
}
```
